page: Amazon Web Services u-6tb1.56xlarge is a dedicated bare-metal style Nitro hypervisor instance tailored specifically for extreme memory footprints. Powered by x86_64 Intel Xeon 8176M processors clocked at 2.1 GHz, the system exposes 224 physical cores across 224 dedicated vCPUs with a single thread per core architecture. It provides an aggregate 6144 GB of DDR4 memory running at 3 GHz, translating to approximately 27.43 GB of RAM per core. The server includes no local instance storage and relies on network-attached storage over an integrated 100 Gbps network baseline. Hardware acceleration features include AVX-512 extensions, AES cryptography, and specialized cache control primitives.

Benchmark results demonstrate exceptional multi-core throughput and raw memory bandwidth, counterbalanced by modest single-threaded performance. The platform achieves a top-tier stress-ng multi-core score of 258,198.57 and a top-tier PassMark CPU score of 101,185.21, whereas single-core stress-ng and Geekbench single-core (1,052.0) sit in average to weak tiers due to the conservative 2.1 GHz base frequency. Large-block memory transfers deliver massive uncached read and write bandwidths of 810.48 GB/sec and 378.57 GB/sec respectively. Network and in-memory execution showcase top-tier scale, handling 261.5 million Redis SET operations per second and 73.07 GB/sec of static web throughput.

Cost efficiency is focused squarely on resource density for massive monolithic datasets. The server trades per-thread execution speed for massive RAM capacity and deterministic dedicated core assignment. With zero built-in local NVMe storage and no discrete GPUs, storage I/O depends heavily on external EBS volumes over the 100 Gbps fabric. Consequently, this server is built primarily for mission-critical enterprise workloads such as large-scale SAP HANA deployments, massive in-memory databases, and heavy enterprise ETL pipelines that require multi-terabyte working memory.
description: Amazon Web Services u-6tb1.56xlarge is a dedicated memory-optimized instance engineered for large in-memory workloads. Built on the AWS Nitro system using the x86_64 architecture, it contains 224 physical Intel Xeon 8176M cores running at 2.1 GHz with dedicated 1:1 vCPU mapping. The platform delivers 6144 GB of DDR4 system memory running at 3 GHz, providing 27.43 GB of memory per core. The instance includes 100 Gbps of baseline networking capacity, contains no integrated local storage, and does not include GPU acceleration. Benchmarks show top-tier multi-threaded compute and memory bandwidth, reaching 810.48 GB/sec in uncached read bandwidth and 261.5 million Redis SET operations per second, though single-core performance remains moderate. The instance is built for large-scale enterprise databases, SAP HANA, and massive in-memory data processing systems.
